# Temple Scroll Column 3 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** 11QT (Cave 11), Col. 3 | **Condition:** Heavily damaged; festival calendar fragments

---

**3:1** [...] the festival [...] in the first month [...]

**3:2** [...] on the fourteenth day of the month [...]

**3:3** [...] at twilight [...] the Passover to the LORD [...]

**3:4** [...] and you shall eat it [...] in the place which [I shall choose ...]

**3:5** [...] unleavened bread [...] for seven days you shall eat [...]

**3:6** [...] and on the first day, a holy convocation [...]

**3:7** [...] you shall do no laborious work [...]

**3:8** [...] and you shall present an offering by fire to the LORD [...]

**3:9** [...] seven days [...] unleavened bread [...]

**3:10** [...] and on the seventh day, a holy convocation to the LORD [...]

---

*LOGOS notes: Column 3 begins the festival calendar with Passover and the Festival of Unleavened Bread, closely paralleling Leviticus 23:5-8 and Numbers 28:16-25. The distinctive feature is the reformulation of third-person Pentateuchal legislation into first-person divine speech. "At twilight" renders bein ha-'arbayim (lit. "between the evenings").*
